# Doodz — Instagram DM Auto-Drawing App for Android

> Doodz is the first Android app that automatically converts any photo, portrait, or logo into a live hand-drawn doodle inside Instagram DMs. Built by ForVano.

## Core Summary
- **Product Name:** Doodz
- **Platform:** Android (APK Direct Download)
- **Target App:** Instagram Direct Message (DM) Doodle Feature (Snapchat & WhatsApp coming soon)
- **Developer:** ForVano (Founder: Junaid Pasha)
- **Contact Email:** junaidpasha9986@gmail.com
- **WhatsApp Support:** +91 78926 89778 (https://wa.me/917892689778)
- **Download URL:** https://forvano.com/Doodz.apk

## How Doodz Solves the Problem
Users want to send impressive artwork in Instagram's DM doodle feature without drawing skills. Doodz uses Android's Accessibility API to automate touch strokes on the screen, converting any reference image into real-time brush strokes.

## Drawing Modes
1. **Standard Mode:** Fast, single-colour line-art doodle. Requires 4 steps (Upload image, select screen area, pick brush, tap Start). Zero calibration needed.
2. **Hyper Doodle Mode:** Detailed multicolour auto-painting. Maps image colours to the closest available shades in Instagram's native doodle palette using a 2-dot calibration (Dot 1 on the colour picker, Dot 2 on the middle-of-screen brush rest point).

## Key Privacy & Security Facts
- **Permissions Required:** Android Accessibility Service only (to execute drawing gestures).
- **Privacy:** 100% on-device processing. User photos and screenshots never leave the phone.
